meta.name: ai-visibility
meta.description: Measure real AI-engine visibility — traffic from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and which pages they cite — from actual GA4 referral data, not prompt sampling. Use when asked "AI visibility", "GEO/AEO check", "do LLMs cite us", "traffic from ChatGPT", or "how do we show up in AI search".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 看清 ChatGPT、Perplexity 等 AI 引擎真正给你带来多少流量、引用了哪些页面。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想弄清 AI 引擎到底有没有给网站带流量、哪些内容被引用。
copy.tagline_en: See which pages ChatGPT and Perplexity cite and how much traffic they send.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know whether AI engines actually send you traffic.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会通过免费的 Ryze MCP 连接器读取你的 GA4 数据,列出 ChatGPT、Perplexity 等 AI 引擎带来的会话、它们实际引用的页面和转化,并给出一个该重写的前 5 个页面清单。
howto.when: 当你提到“AI visibility”“GEO/AEO check”等关键词,或问 AI 搜索里的曝光情况和 ChatGPT 带来的流量时,它会接管。

say.text: 我们的 AI visibility 怎么样?各引擎带来多少会话?
say.note: 它会调 GA4 出各 AI 引擎的会话对比表。

say.text: ChatGPT 和 Perplexity 都引用我们哪些页面?
say.note: 返回被引用的落地页及其转化。

say.text: 按被引用页面的写法,列出该重写的 5 个页面。
say.note: 先读被引用页,再对照搜索表现找漏掉的页。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads your GA4 data through the free Ryze MCP connector and reports sessions from ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI engines, the pages they cite with conversions, plus a top-5 list of pages to restructure.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "AI visibility", "GEO/AEO check" or ask about AI search exposure and ChatGPT referral traffic; it needs the free Ryze MCP connector.

say_en.text: How is our AI visibility — how many sessions come from each AI engine?
say_en.note: It pulls the GA4 per-engine session table.

say_en.text: Which of our pages do ChatGPT and Perplexity cite?
say_en.note: Returns cited landing pages with conversions.

say_en.text: List 5 pages to restructure, based on our top cited pages.
say_en.note: Reads winning pages, then finds the misses.
